Apparently… you’re not even answering the phone correctly now.

Say “hello”? Wrong.
Don’t correct someone when they say your name wrong? Also wrong.
Miss one recruiter call? Blacklisted.

In this video, we go through some of the latest job advice and recruiter takes — and why it feels like no matter what you do, it’s somehow the wrong move.

We also get into the classic “just work for free” advice… and why that keeps getting pushed.

This is what the job search looks like right now.

Let me know what you think.
title: LINKEDIN RECRUITERS LOSING THEIR MINDS!
